decision: Plan drafted from operator directive 2026-06-09 after C0 (2026-06-09-001) round-6 pause. Provenance: six paid sufficiency rounds on C0 (finding counts 3->2->4->3->4->5), each clearing 100% of the prior round's findings and surfacing a fresh matrix layer — the gate is an unbounded contract enumerator with no stopping condition, the analog of the problem the implementation volley loop solved with Design B strictly-shrinking-count convergence breakers (plan 2026-05-30-002). Scope is the operator's 4-point spec verbatim: round tracking + finding classes, convergence policy (full-clearance + medium/low pin-class -> operator disposition; new high -> block; new plan_contract -> block unless waived), disposition artifact (4 kinds), dogfood against the six C0 rounds as offline fixtures. C0 itself stays draft and is NOT unlocked by this plan; returning to C0 under the new policy is the follow-up step.
rationale: Convergence rule first, then C0 — operator-sequenced. The C0 history doubles as the fixture corpus, making the dogfood feature cheap and honest.

decision: SELF-DEADLOCK GUARD (per the no-self-deadlocking-plans precedent affirmed at plan 2026-04-30-001): this plan modifies the very pre-impl sufficiency gate that would lock it, so it must not be held hostage by the defect it fixes. Budget: at most ONE paid lock attempt. High-severity or genuinely conceptual findings from that attempt are addressed normally; but if the attempt exhibits the non-convergence pattern this plan exists to fix (full clearance of prior findings + a fresh layer of medium/low pin-class findings), the operator may lock with --ignore-sufficiency-findings citing this D-entry as the recorded reason. No automatic override — the operator makes the call either way.
rationale: A convergence-fix plan spiraling in the unconverged gate would be self-parody; the bounded budget plus recorded-override path keeps the fix landable while preserving the gate's authority over real gaps.

decision: Operator approved spending the single D002 paid lock attempt (2026-06-09) and pinned two implementation invariants to preserve: (1) CONSERVATIVE FALLBACK — missing or invalid classifier data MUST become plan_contract (blocking-eligible), never an eligible-for-disposition class; (2) STRICT INVALIDATION — the disposition invalidation rule must be strict enough that a materially changed finding cannot hide behind an old waiver (when in doubt, re-surface as blocking). If the lock attempt itself starts the non-convergent pattern, use the D002 recorded-override path rather than letting the meta-gate eat more budget. After landing: return to C0 and apply the recorded split.
rationale: Both invariants are fail-closed defaults: classification uncertainty and waiver staleness should always err toward blocking, since the policy's whole purpose is to bound spend without weakening the gate's authority over real gaps.

decision: The single D002 paid lock attempt REFUSED with 6 findings (1 critical / 3 high / 2 medium) — NOT the non-convergence pattern (first round, genuine design contradictions), so addressed normally per D002 rather than overridden: (1 CRITICAL) no explicit no-auditor lock path after dispositions -> F002 now pins the disposition-resolution path (dispositions cover latest round + unchanged input_fingerprint -> lock proceeds with ZERO auditor invocations, no new round appended; F001 appends rounds only when the auditor actually runs); (2 HIGH) content-derived ids contradicted invalidation-on-changed-content -> F001 redefined to TWO-LEVEL identity: stable SEMANTIC id from locator fields (journey+gap_class+feature_refs+ordinal, no free text) + separate content fingerprint; material change = same id, new fingerprint; dispositions bind id+fingerprint (F003); (3 HIGH) generic disposition suppression weakened the plan_contract waiver rule -> per-class validity: deferred_to_impl / split_to_followup_plan REFUSED for plan_contract, only waived_with_reason or a clearing plan edit neutralizes it (F002+F003+CLI); (4 HIGH) C0 replay vs conservative fallback parity contradiction -> F004 fixtures carry explicit RETROSPECTIVE class annotations (operator-reviewed fixture metadata) plus a companion test proving the un-annotated corpus falls back to plan_contract and blocks; (5 MED) policy not exhaustive over the enum -> eligible-class set pinned as {matrix_pin, implementation_detail, editorial, scope_guard} at med/low (consistent with the operator's C0 round-6 split where editorial+scope_guard findings were disposition-eligible) and a test enumerates the full severity x class matrix incl. the unclassified fallback; (6 MED) accepted_into_plan underspecified -> stays BLOCKING until the plan input_fingerprint actually changes from the one bound at disposition time. PAUSED before any re-lock: the one authorized paid call is spent; per the one-paid-call discipline a second requires explicit operator approval. Options surfaced: (a) one verification re-lock on the materially-revised plan, or (b) recorded override citing D002 since all 6 findings are now addressed in acceptance text.
rationale: The auditor caught real contradictions (especially the id-semantics bug) — exactly what the gate is for; addressing beats overriding. But budget authority stays with the operator: no second paid call without an explicit go.

decision: The D004 fixes pushed F002 over the free design gate's limits (3 surfaces in one AC: block-severity over_surface + likely_timeout, plus a forward reference to F003's waived_with_reason token). Resolved structurally per the lint's own suggestion: SPLIT F002 into F002 (pure convergence policy function — core only, references the waiver disposition descriptively instead of by F003's token) and NEW F005 (lock-path wiring: refusal branch naming, the no_auditor_resolution disposition-resolution path with zero paid calls, and the changed-fingerprint fallback to the plain gate). Plan is now 5 features; plan-review verdict OK with 0 block-severity flags (3 advisory over_surface warns remain).
rationale: The policy/wiring split is also better engineering: the pure function is independently testable and the 600s-dispatch sizing concern disappears.

decision: Operator approved ONE verification re-lock (paid call #2 on this plan, 2026-06-09) with a firm boundary tree: clears -> lock and implement; only medium/low eligible-class policy pins -> use the D002 recorded-override path; another high/critical contradiction -> fix that ONCE and pause (no spiral). Rationale accepted: the round-1 findings were real contradictions in the meta-gate design (semantic-id/fingerprint split, zero-auditor path) and the fixes changed the plan materially — for governance code, a second audit verifies that the thing meant to stop paid spirals does not itself create a loophole or a new paid loop.
rationale: Operator-paced budget with an explicit terminal branch for every outcome — the same bounded shape this plan institutionalizes.

decision: Verification re-lock (paid call #2, D006-approved) REFUSED with 6 NEW findings (4 high / 2 medium) — the D004 fixes all cleared, but the high branch of the D006 tree fires: FIXED ONCE, now PAUSED, no third call without operator direction. Fixes: (1 HIGH wiring) accepted_into_plan vs F005 fresh-audit conflict resolved by an explicit kind split — accepted_into_plan means 'operator will edit the plan' and deliberately routes through the plain gate (fresh audit); ONLY deferred_to_impl / waived_with_reason / split_to_followup_plan participate in the no-paid resolution path (features + objective_contract completion test aligned); (2 HIGH coverage) the content fingerprint now hashes severity + class + description + recommendation, so a severity or class escalation is always a material change that invalidates dispositions; (3 HIGH parity) my own artifact drift fixed — objective_contract now names the same 4-class eligible set as features.json; (4 HIGH coverage) same-cell ordinals are assigned by deterministic fingerprint sort (never auditor output order), and ANY change to a cell's finding set invalidates every disposition bound to that cell, fail-closed per D003; (5 MED) the policy matrix now covers the full severity vocabulary including advisory (advisory never hard-blocks, matching the existing gate) and advisory joins medium/low in branch (a); (6 MED) legacy --ignore-sufficiency-findings/override.json interaction pinned: it remains the blunt whole-plan escape hatch, takes precedence, bypasses dispositions, is recorded exactly as today, and its use is logged in the rounds ledger. STATUS: plan still draft; awaiting operator choice between the D002 recorded-override path (now 12 findings addressed across 2 real audit rounds) and any further step.
rationale: Round 2 again caught real contradictions (notably accepted_into_plan colliding with the completion test, and the ordinal-drift identity hole) — the verification call did exactly what the operator predicted: checked that the anti-spiral mechanism does not itself create a loophole. Boundary honored: fix once, pause.
